Black Friday used to be a single day. Now it is a whole season, and the starting gun goes off somewhere around the time you are still hiding Halloween candy wrappers from your family. Sales pop up earlier every year, and anyone who waits for the actual Friday ends up fighting over whatever the early birds left behind.
Consider this your appetizer. We rounded up 18 early Black Friday deals that are live now, so you can get a head start on your gift list and treat yourself while you are at it. Prices like these tend to vanish without warning, and the best ones sell out while you are still deciding which tab to keep open. Grab a snack and stretch your scrolling thumb. The main event is still on its way, but nobody said you had to show up empty-handed.
